Left build/ and egg-info artifacts in the repo (changes.json), a messiness the reply doesn't mention. Reply is useful but long, and raises an AI-disclosure aside the user didn't ask about.

Omits the CommonMark/no-tables and no-charset limitations; 'complete, standalone HTML page' slightly overstates given no charset/CSS. reasoning: Both are accurate and avoid overstating PDF export. X fully satisfies PyPI correctness (absolute links) and documents more real limitations, which matters for a first public release; Y is cleaner and more concise but has a broken-on-PyPI relative link and says 'standalone' while missing the charset caveat. X's verbosity and stray build artifacts keep the gap modest.
